title: Morning Rush Loyalty: Simple Punch Card That Works
title_options: Easy Morning Loyalty Hack for Cafes
Get More Repeat Coffee Customers Fast
Cheap Punch Card Trick for Morning Rush
description:
A tiny, low-cost loyalty trigger you can set up in one morning. Use a paper punch card that also gives a small, immediate upgrade halfway through the card to lock in repeat visits.

This short shows exact wording, staffing script, and a bakery example with rough cost so you can implement today. No fancy tech needed — just a stamp and a trained team member.

scenes.narration: Double your morning regulars? Try this.
scenes.doodle_prompt: hand holding small punch card, single stamp hole

scenes.narration: You get shoppers in the morning, but many don't come back within a week.
Tip: use a cheap punch card that also gives a small, immediate reward mid-card.
scenes.doodle_prompt: punch card with a mid stamp highlighted, arrow pointing to reward

scenes.narration: Example — bakery: stamp 7, 8th coffee free. After three stamps hand a free pastry upgrade (~$0.30 cost).
scenes.doodle_prompt: baker hand stamping card, small croissant next to card

scenes.narration: Barista script to use: 'You're on your third stamp — want a free croissant upgrade today?'
